company.name: Amprius
company.shortDescription: Amprius is a leader in silicon-anode lithium-ion batteries, delivering the highest-energy commercial cells in real world applications.
company.description: Amprius Technologies, Inc. is a leading manufacturer of high-energy and high-power lithium-ion batteries, producing the industry’s highest-known energy density cells. The Company’s commercially available SiCore® and SiMaxx™ batteries deliver up to 450 Wh/kg and 1,150 Wh/L, with third-party validation of 500Wh/kg and 1,300 Wh/L. The Company’s corporate headquarters is in Fremont, California, where it maintains an R&D lab and a MWh scale manufacturing facility for the fabrication of silicon anodes and cells.

aiResearchSummary.text: Amprius is engaged in research and development of nanostructures for lithium-ion battery electrodes, focusing on the structurally controlled deposition of silicon onto nanowires. Their work includes methods for fabricating a nanostructure template with a silicon coating, which may feature both a non-conformal, porous layer and a conformal, denser layer. These activities highlight Amprius’s focus on advanced silicon nanowire anode technologies for lithium-ion batteries.
